purpose: Control how repeated micro-Sequence evidence becomes a reusable pattern without collapsing observation, interpretation, user meaning and universal rubric truth.

pattern_namespaces.meaning: one closed event/utterance representation; not a reusable pattern
source-linked candidate awaiting review; no direct action authority
user-approved interpretation/pattern applicable to that user's own future reasoning scope
pattern scoped to a named relationship/entity context; not globally generalized
proposal to change formal Human/AI/ASI/Wisdom/Sequence rubric; source rubrics remain unchanged until versioned adoption

candidate_creation.minimum_rule: Candidate formation requires a meaningful typed relation/difference pattern across evidence, or an explicit user request. Repetition count is evidence, not a universal fixed threshold.
candidate_creation.intent_guard: Observed behavior may support an intent hypothesis. Intent is OBSERVED only when the evidence itself establishes the intent; otherwise use INFERRED, USER_ATTRIBUTED or UNKNOWN.

immutability_rules: Raw source sentence/event is immutable after source lock.
Machine interpretation proposal is immutable as provenance after review is opened.
User edit does not overwrite the machine proposal; it creates a new review decision object.
Approved pattern revision creates a new version linked to the prior version.
Counter-evidence is added; it is not deleted to preserve a preferred pattern.

promotion_rules.PERSONAL_PATTERN: May be approved directly by authorized user/editor after provenance is visible.
promotion_rules.RELATIONSHIP_SPECIFIC_PATTERN: May be approved directly by authorized user/editor with entity/scope boundary.
promotion_rules.DOMAIN_PATTERN: Requires domain review contract and R-F-R status.
promotion_rules.GENERAL_PATTERN_CANDIDATE: May be retained and reused only as candidate/inference until adopted under a higher contract.
promotion_rules.RUBRIC_CHANGE_CANDIDATE: Must pass the formal registry adoption/version migration path; no in-place modification of approved native IDs/definitions.

activation_rule: Future input may activate an approved scoped pattern only if its applicability/context/actor/view conditions match. Candidate patterns may be shown as hypotheses but cannot silently drive execution thresholds.
learning_rule: Learning is structured write-back: new evidence/relation/memory/pattern/version changes future execution. It does not imply model-weight self-update.
